chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: Read the Current on Nibbit, then All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit.
q2_other_line_considered: All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit followed by Coral Guard, trading damage for 5 Block against the incoming attack.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 5 Block and therefore accepted the full telegraphed 12 damage in exchange for more damage to Nibbit.
q4_different_intent: Yes. A sufficiently larger telegraphed attack would have made me play Coral Guard alongside All Streams Flow to the Sea.
